Home-pick rate baseline 37.6% vs candidate 36.7% (close together, little home-tilt artifact here). Within-week permutation null (200 perms, real feature) centres at +0.263 pts, sd 0.681; observed -0.668 sits at the 8.0th percentile of its own null. Positive control (candidate column replaced by realized ats_margin) showed +48.999 pts, P+ 1.000, proving the full-profile ridge harness is not blind. NOT commensurable with graph_ratings_v2_team_stat (bare-baseline comparator) or graph_off_sack_rate_on_production (different candidate family) -- recorded under its own family per AGENTS.md pooling-commensurability rule.
